subject: Re: Connector chargeflow addendum - invoicing & escrow triggers
messages:
From: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@cloudbridge.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cloudbridge.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 14:03:00 -0000
Subject: CloudBridge redlines for connector chargeflow addendum

Hi Marissa / Redwood team,

Attached are our proposed redlines to the addendum (MSA + Order Form) for the CloudBridge marketplace listing. Two quick asks up front: 1) confirm whether Redwood will accept pass-through invoicing to CloudBridge vs invoicing the end customer; and 2) confirm the escrow/audit trigger language — we need to know what evidence (invoices, rev reports) triggers an escrow review and what the timeline looks like.

We redlined section 3.4 (Fee Routing) to require a 45-day window for evidence submission before a hold/escrow can be initiated. We also suggested a carveout for chargebacks routed through a distributor.

Attached: CloudBridge_addendum_redlines_20261125.pdf

Can we have a short sync this week? Samantha
Samantha Reed
Head of Partnerships, CloudBridge
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:11:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CloudBridge redlines for connector chargeflow addendum

Thanks Samantha — received and appreciate the clear asks. Quick response while we gather legal input:

- On invoicing: Redwood typically invoices the end customer (seller) but supports a pass-through model for select channel partners when we have a reseller addendum + evidence flow documented. We'll need CloudBridge to confirm whether the partner prefers pass-through invoicing or distributor rebilling; that choice affects the audit trail and GL treatment.

- Escrow/audit trigger: 45 days seems reasonable as a request; Redwood legal will want language that allows us to cure data discrepancies within that window (e.g., 15 business days for Redwood to provide supporting logs) before funds are escrowed.

I've looped in Ben and Laura to align on operational implications and legal redline. Can Ben propose ops language and Laura propose legal language? If comfortable, we can do a 30-minute call on Friday (Nov 28).

Thanks,
Marissa
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CloudBridge redlines for connector chargeflow addendum

Marissa / Samantha — operational notes from the ops side:

- For pass-through we need an explicit mapping in the Order Form for 'billing owner' and 'collection owner' so finance can route invoices automatically. Suggest adding a short table to the OF: Billing owner = CloudBridge (if pass-through), Collection owner = Redwood (if we still collect).

- On the 45-day escrow trigger: instead of an absolute escrow hold at day 46, propose an escalation path: Day 0: partner submits dispute evidence; Day 15: Redwood provides internal sales & usage logs; Day 30: joint reconciliation window closes; Day 45: if unresolved, funds may be flagged for temporary hold pending arbitration (DocSec). This gives both sides steps to resolve and is easier for ops to implement.

- Attached is a working diff with a suggested 'conduit fee routing' paragraph and a sample OF snippet: RBW-proposed-chargeflow-diff_v2.docx

If CloudBridge is open, we can lock this language and move to a DocuSign OF patch.

-ben
Ben Carter
Lead, Channel Ops | Redwood Inference

Forwarded message follows: please see Redwood legal position below.

On Mon, Nov 29, 2026 at 16:42 PM laura_bennett@redwood.com wrote:

> Samantha / CloudBridge team — thanks for the redlines and for calling out the 45-day window. A few legal points we need on the record:
>
> 1) Cure period mechanics — Redwood requests an express 15-business-day cure window after we provide logs/evidence; language must include the format of evidence (CSV rev reports + S3 access logs + ticket reference) so there's no ambiguity.
>
> 2) Escrow trigger threshold — we cannot agree to an automatic escrow for disputes below $10k without a manual review; propose a threshold clause and an option for expedited escrow if both parties approve in writing.
>
> 3) Distributor carveouts — we accept distributor routing but require representation that the distributor is bound by substantially similar audit & retention obligations or Redwood will not accept pass-through invoicing.
>
> 4) Confidentiality & limited disclosure — when sharing invoices and usage logs, parties must follow the NDA data handling appendix; we added cross-reference language.
>
> I've applied tracked changes to the OF snippet (see attached) and added bracketed text for the threshold and cure mechanics. If CloudBridge accepts, please confirm and we'll prepare a DocuSign amendment for the OF. If you'd like, we can schedule a short legal ops call Wed 11/30 10am PT to finalize.
>
> -Laura
> Laura Bennett
> Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
